# Badge

A short label on an item: a category, a count or a status.

- Status: implemented
- Category: feedback
- Pattern: HTML `<span>`
- Text style: `caption` (`.nd-text-caption`)

## Anatomy

- **container**: Pill.
- **label**: One or two words.

## Variants

- `neutral`:
- `info`:
- `success`:
- `warning`:
- `danger`:

## States

- `default`: Status badges carry a word, not colour alone.

## Accessibility

- Role: none
- A count badge has visually hidden context ("3 unread").

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.1 Use of Color (A)
- 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)

## Contrast

Each pair meets its ratio in every theme and direction (checked on every build).

| `badge.text` | `badge.fill` | 4.5:1 |
| `text.primary` | `badge.info.fill` | 4.5:1 |
| `text.primary` | `badge.success.fill` | 4.5:1 |
| `text.primary` | `badge.warning.fill` | 4.5:1 |
| `text.primary` | `badge.danger.fill` | 4.5:1 |

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-cluster">
  <span class="nd-badge">Neutral</span>
  <span class="nd-badge" data-status="info">Info</span>
  <span class="nd-badge" data-status="success">Success</span>
  <span class="nd-badge" data-status="warning">Warning</span>
  <span class="nd-badge" data-status="danger">Danger</span>
</div>
```
